# Feature catalogue

Oxbox has 49 implemented tool routes in 7 categories. The platform column describes source
availability, not completed manual certification. Review [usage](USAGE.md), [provider limits](ROADMAP_TOOLS.md),
the [49-tool acceptance matrix](../tasks/native-migration.md) and [release gates](RELEASE.md) before inferring
support. Hardware, OS/session permissions and optional local providers can limit individual actions.

## Productivity

| Tool / stable ID | Purpose | Platforms in source | Limits / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Transform Text**<br>`transform-text` | Switch text between UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, snake_case and more | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Clipboard History**<br>`clipboard-history` | Keep recent copied text and images and paste any of them again | Windows, macOS, Linux | Opt-in monitoring. History is kept in memory; review clipboard privacy limits before enabling it. |
| **Unit Converter**<br>`unit-converter` | Convert length, mass, temperature, data size and time | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Window on Top**<br>`window-on-top` | Keep a chosen window above other windows | Windows | Windows native window controls; some protected applications may refuse changes. |
| **Window Manager**<br>`window-manager` | Place windows in halves, thirds or quarters of a display | Windows | Windows native window controls; minimum window sizes can constrain layouts. |
| **Show Desktop**<br>`show-desktop` | Minimize application windows to reveal the desktop | Windows | Windows only. Restores the windows tracked by this session. |
| **Focus on Window**<br>`focus-window` | Dim the space around a chosen window | Windows | Windows dimming overlays; multi-monitor runtime acceptance is still open. |
| **Launch App Sets**<br>`launch-app-sets` | Save and open a reviewed group of local apps or files | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Presentation Mode**<br>`presentation-mode` | Coordinate keep-awake and desktop visibility for a presentation | Windows, macOS, Linux | Combines keep-awake with supported desktop controls. Notification settings remain manual OS controls. |
| **Recognize Text**<br>`recognize-text` | Extract text from a local image using an available offline OCR engine | Windows, macOS, Linux | Windows OCR uses installed language packs. Other platforms require user-installed Tesseract and language data. |
| **Currency Converter**<br>`currency-converter` | Convert dated reference rates with offline import and opt-in ECB refresh | Windows, macOS, Linux | Import dated reference rates locally, or explicitly opt into a manual ECB HTTPS refresh. Reference rates are not live trading quotes. |

## Time

| Tool / stable ID | Purpose | Platforms in source | Limits / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Break Time**<br>`break-time` | Get gentle reminders to step away from the screen | Windows, macOS, Linux | Notifications require permission. Full-screen activity detection is best effort. |
| **Timer &amp; Stopwatch**<br>`timer-stopwatch` | Count down to zero or measure elapsed time with laps | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **World Time**<br>`world-time` | See the current time in cities around the world | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Alarm**<br>`alarm` | Schedule local reminders with time-zone and recurrence controls | Windows, macOS, Linux | Requires notification permission and Oxbox to remain running; the app does not wake a powered-off computer. |
| **Date Countdown**<br>`date-countdown` | Count down to dated events in explicit time zones | Windows, macOS, Linux | Uses explicit time zones. Notifications require permission and a running app. |

| **Verify Checksum**<br>`verify-checksum` | Hash a file with SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5 or BLAKE3 and compare it | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |

## Screen Capture

| Tool / stable ID | Purpose | Platforms in source | Limits / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Screenshot**<br>`screenshot` | Capture the whole screen, a window or an area to file and clipboard | Windows, macOS, Linux | Capture permissions and desktop-session restrictions apply, especially on Wayland. |
| **Record Screen**<br>`record-screen` | Record a screen, area or window with explicit start and stop | Windows, Linux | Requires FFmpeg. Linux recording currently uses X11; macOS and Wayland recording are unavailable through this provider. |
| **Take Photo**<br>`take-photo` | Capture a photo from an explicitly selected camera | Windows, macOS, Linux | Requires FFmpeg, a supported camera and OS camera permission. |
| **Take Video**<br>`take-video` | Record a selected camera with visible controls and a duration limit | Windows, macOS, Linux | Requires FFmpeg and camera permission. Camera recording does not include microphone audio. |

## Images &amp; Media

| Tool / stable ID | Purpose | Platforms in source | Limits / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Resize Images**<br>`resize-images` | Resize one or many images and convert between formats | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **QR &amp; Barcode**<br>`qr-code` | Turn text or a link into a QR code or barcode image | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Mute Microphone**<br>`mute-microphone` | Inspect and toggle the default input-device mute state | Windows, Linux | Windows default input device; Linux requires a working pactl/PulseAudio-compatible server. |
| **Record Audio**<br>`record-audio` | Record an explicitly selected audio input to a new local file | Windows, macOS, Linux | Requires your own FFmpeg installation, a supported input device, and OS permission. |
| **Make GIF**<br>`make-gif` | Create a local animated GIF from a video segment | Windows, macOS, Linux | Requires your own FFmpeg installation. Converts a selected local video segment. |
| **Convert Audio / Video**<br>`convert-audio-video` | Convert local media with reviewed offline format presets | Windows, macOS, Linux | Requires your own FFmpeg installation. Available codecs depend on that build. |
| **Barcode Reader**<br>`barcode-reader` | Read QR codes and supported barcodes from a local image | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Measure Color**<br>`measure-color` | Sample an image or screen pixel as HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK | Windows, macOS, Linux | Local-image sampling works without screen permission; screen sampling inherits capture restrictions. |

## System

| Tool / stable ID | Purpose | Platforms in source | Limits / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **System Monitor**<br>`system-monitor` | Watch CPU, memory, disk and the busiest processes in one view | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Network Usage**<br>`network-usage` | See live upload and download speed and totals | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Do Not Sleep**<br>`do-not-sleep` | Keep the computer and display awake for as long as you need | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |
| **Sleep Timer**<br>`sleep-timer` | Put the computer to sleep or shut it down after a countdown | Windows, macOS, Linux | Explicit confirmation before arming a power action. Cancel from the launcher banner. |
| **Mouse Activity**<br>`mouse-activity` | Gently move the pointer while idle and automatically yield when you return | Windows | Windows only. Starts only when you choose, moves the pointer while idle, and yields when input resumes. Stop from the app or tray. |
| **Close Apps**<br>`close-apps` | Review open windows and request that selected apps close | Windows | Requests normal window closure after review. Applications may show their own save prompts. |
| **Switch Resolution**<br>`switch-resolution` | Try a display mode with an automatic rollback countdown | Windows | Windows only. A confirmation countdown automatically requests rollback if you do not keep the mode. |
| **Eject Volumes**<br>`eject-volumes` | Review removable volumes and request a safe eject | Windows | Windows only. Busy or protected devices can refuse an eject request. |
| **Energy Saver**<br>`energy-saver` | Choose an available operating-system power plan | Windows | Selects an available Windows power plan; available plans depend on the device. |
| **Hidden Files**<br>`hidden-files` | Show or hide hidden files in the system file manager | Windows, macOS | Uses file-manager settings on Windows and macOS; changing macOS settings can restart Finder. |
| **CPU Temperature**<br>`cpu-temperature` | Read temperature sensors exposed by the operating system | Windows, macOS, Linux | Only sensors exposed by the system are available. Many Windows devices expose none. |
| **Uninstall Apps**<br>`uninstall-apps` | Review registered uninstallers and separately inspect leftovers | Windows | Windows registered uninstallers. Leftover inspection is separate from uninstalling. |
| **Do Not Disturb**<br>`do-not-disturb` | Open the supported system controls for notification interruptions | Windows, macOS | Opens supported OS settings. You change the notification mode yourself. |
| **Airplane Mode**<br>`airplane-mode` | Open Windows controls for wireless radios and airplane mode | Windows | Opens Windows airplane-mode settings. You control the radios in Windows. |

## Privacy &amp; Security

| Tool / stable ID | Purpose | Platforms in source | Limits / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Lock Screen**<br>`lock-screen` | Lock the computer instantly | Windows, macOS, Linux | macOS uses display sleep; immediate password protection depends on your OS settings. |
| **Hide Desktop**<br>`hide-desktop` | Hide desktop icons for presentations and screen sharing | Windows, macOS | Changes desktop icon visibility. Linux is not supported. |
| **Encrypt Files**<br>`encrypt-files` | Protect files with a passphrase using modern age encryption | Windows, macOS, Linux | See the usage guide and acceptance matrix. |

## Contribute

Start with [the contribution walkthrough](GETTING_STARTED.md). Use the stable ID in bug reports and regression
tests. Update the canonical catalogue and run `node scripts/build-community-docs.mjs` when metadata changes;
CI uses `--check` to detect stale generated documentation. The native, legacy and website interfaces read
the same metadata. See [catalogue maintenance](../catalog/README.md).
